model_output.verdict: A marketing executive’s resume with team, budget, growth, and launch results attached.
write_up: You come across as a CMO with a substantial SaaS marketing organization and a track record across demand generation, launches, and brand. A recruiter has plenty to take forward; the main questions are what changed in the launch process and what your P&L responsibility covered.
The multi-channel campaign line is a good model: it names the strategy, the growth in qualified leads, and your contribution to recurring revenue growth without claiming sole credit.

cards.line: - I decided to revamp the product launch process, shortening time-to-market by 30% and increasing launch success rate to 90%, resulting in a $15M incremental revenue increase over 2 years.
cards.cannot_tell: The results are substantial, but the revamp itself is a black box. A reader also doesn't know how you defined a successful launch.
cards.example: I decided to revamp the product launch process by [what changed], shortening time-to-market by 30% and increasing launch success rate to 90% [how success was defined], resulting in a $15M incremental revenue increase over 2 years.
cards.question: What changed in the launch process, and how did you define a successful launch?

cards.cannot_tell: The experience section shows a marketing budget, but it doesn't explain your P&L responsibilities. That's a distinction a reader will care about for an executive role.
cards.question: Which parts of the P&L were you responsible for?
